public_task_spec.source: Didi et al., FLIP2, ICML 2026 Spotlight; official FLIP2 website and download asset
public_task_spec.scientific_context: Bacillus subtilis alpha amylase variants are measured by stain-removal activity, a detergent-relevant enzyme-engineering endpoint.
public_task_spec.source_partition: Official train and validation variants with zero or one mutation.
public_task_spec.deployment_partition: Official test variants with more than one mutation.
public_task_spec.optimization_endpoint: Best-so-far stain-removal activity AUC under three initial target observations and twelve additional reveals.
public_task_spec.candidate_skill: Estimate shrunk per-mutation effects from completed low-order source measurements, sum exact supported effects for each higher-order target candidate, and blend the source rank with target-only GP-UCB under fixed decaying authority.

coverage_aware_gate.coverage_rescue_rule: A calibration route whose confidence interval crosses zero may authorize transfer only when its mean effect is positive, its exact-token coverage is at most 0.10, deployment exact-token coverage exceeds it by at least 0.75, and all deployment applicability thresholds pass. A negative calibration mean is never rescued.

public_task_spec.evidence_constraint: Official test activity values are unavailable to the LLM, structural coverage computation, gate decision, skill selector, candidate sampler, and protocol author at freeze time.
public_task_spec.public_target_adapter: The gate receives a public-sequence-only deployment adapter that stores zero as a placeholder objective and excludes measured activity metadata. Outcome-noninterference is tested by changing target values while holding sequences fixed.
public_task_spec.development_history: The rule is motivated by the preregistered TrpB false-negative hold and must therefore be evaluated only on this previously unused family. TrpB outcomes cannot enter the Amylase confirmatory endpoint.
public_task_spec.claim_boundary: This protocol can provide prospective finite-pool evidence for or against one coverage-aware routing rule on one external enzyme family. It is not a wet-lab discovery, a universal safety proof, or a population generalization estimate.

prompt.system: You are the semantic transfer planner in a preregistered scientific optimization protocol. You may use only the supplied public task metadata. You have no experimental target values. Decide whether the bounded additive-mutation skill is scientifically justified. Return JSON only and never invent observed performance.

failure_conditions: Deployment exact-token coverage of summed per-mutation effects falls below 0.90, meaning many multi-mutant test variants contain mutations never observed singly in the source split, so the additive sum is unsupported.
Deployment full-exact candidate coverage below 0.80 or per-candidate evidence coverage below 0.95, indicating the additive prior cannot rank enough target variants on supported tokens.
Calibration mean AUC delta is negative or zero, indicating the additive source signal does not transfer even before applying the coverage rescue.
Strong epistatic (non-additive) interactions in Amylase multi-mutants make summed single-mutant effects a biased rank estimator, degrading GP-UCB blending despite good token coverage.
Low-information calibration route with exact-token coverage above 0.10 fails the rescue eligibility, blocking transfer.
Outcome-noninterference test fails (gate decision changes when target values change while sequences held fixed), signaling leakage of unavailable activity metadata.
parsed_hypothesis.hypothesis: Shrunk per-mutation effects estimated from the 488 reported single mutants and low-order source variants, summed over supported tokens for multi-mutation test candidates, yield a source rank that, blended with target-only GP-UCB under fixed decaying authority, improves best-so-far stain-removal activity AUC within 12 reveals relative to target-only GP-UCB.
parsed_hypothesis.mechanism: The one-to-many split provides dense single-mutant coverage (488 reported single mutants) that lets us estimate additive per-position effects. Summing these exact supported effects approximates the activity landscape of higher-order test variants under a first-order additivity assumption. This additive rank is combined with target-only GP-UCB through a fixed decaying authority so early reveals lean on the source prior while later reveals defer to on-target observations, subject to the coverage-aware gate confirming sufficient token and candidate coverage.
parsed_hypothesis.rationale: The task is structurally favorable for a bounded additive-mutation prior: the source partition (zero/one mutation train+validation) directly supplies the single-mutation effects the skill needs, and the deployment partition (>1 mutation test variants) is exactly the higher-order regime where summed effects apply. The decaying authority and coverage-aware gate protect against over-trusting the source. Because official test activity values are withheld from every component at freeze time and outcome-noninterference is tested, selection is not contaminated by target outcomes. This family is the correct confirmatory venue since TrpB motivated but cannot enter the Amylase endpoint. The recommendation is conditional: skill is justified only if the preregistered coverage gate (deployment exact-token >= 0.90, full-exact candidate >= 0.80, per-candidate evidence >= 0.95) and a non-negative calibration mean pass at evaluation time; the coverage rescue may only apply with a positive calibration mean and the specified coverage-gap thresholds.
parsed_hypothesis.transfer_scope: Transfer only shrunk additive per-mutation effect estimates from the completed low-order source (train+validation, zero/one mutation) to rank official test variants with more than one mutation on the Amylase stain-removal AUC endpoint, blended under fixed decaying authority with target-only GP-UCB, gated by coverage_conditioned_additive_v1. No transfer of TrpB outcomes, no wet-lab discovery claim, no population generalization beyond this finite Amylase test pool.
